stdout.head:
widgets keeps a local list of widgets.

Usage:
  widgets [command]

Available Commands:
  account     Show the account the token belongs to
  add         Add a widget
  count       Count widgets
  list        List widgets
  remove      Remove a widget (destructive)

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for widgets
